company_info.company_description: "At All Green Environmental Solutions, "We Know Solar" and we pride ourselves on great service, quality solar systems and renewable energy solutions.Why use us?Australian Owned and operatedOwner installers in business since 200910-year installation warranty and guaranteeWe’ve installed over 20,000 systems across NSWHundreds of reviewsPartnerships with some of the world’s leading solar manufacturers.Dedicated quality service team.Our after-sales service is second to none.The fact we don’t use sub-contractors, only employees."

reviews.review_description: Sales people very helpful and knowledgeable advice on cell placement gives us good supply from sunrise till sun set.Instillation and trades excellent.

EVNex Charger Installation. Flat roof, so wiring had to go through the under-floor space, up a wall, across under a carport roof, through a wall, down inside the garage, and back through the wall. All done very tidily and professionally. Charger is working perfectly, set up to only use surplus feed to grid (after home battery has charged). No more selling my surplus solar for peanuts!
From quoting to cleaning up All Green where professional throughout the process to supply and install a Tesla Powerwall 3 and a Powerwall 3 Expansion unit.

Mark and the team at All Green Environmental Solutions were amazing to deal with and that's why I got them back to install a 2nd battery. Price was very competitive and Bryce and the boys who installed it were very professional and cleaned up everything afterwards like you wouldn't have known they were here.  Highly recommend them for your solar and battery installations.
Quoting process was effortless. Installation undertaken on the day and time as promised with no fuss from installer.

The quoting was no preasure with 3 options offered to cover battery with blackout, off-grid solar blackout and an alternative to Tesla. They kept us informed about rebate changes between quote and install.  We also asked for an EV charger.  We went with Alpha ESS.  Installer was polite, tidy and punctual.  Installer provided training on App.

Must say dealing with Mark has been a delight. He is knowledgeable and helpful in suggesting what should be purchased without being pushy. Excellent customer service.Timely reminders for day of installation and installers were punctual. Very efficient and tidy.A bit remiss was installer did not advise us that according to government requirements for battery installations, they are required to also put in a smoke detector. We had to ask if it was battery operated and how often should the batteries be replaced.A suggestion that might increase customer service satisfaction - perhaps installers be familiar with apps clients will use with their new installation. Installer apps are not available to the clients so it is not much use showing this to the customer. Just because they are not familiar with the product app, they shouldn't be dismissive should the client wishes to ask a few questions as more and more customers are now quite tech savvy.Overall, happy with what was purchased.Can recommend All Green Environmental Solutions.

Very happy with All Green Environmental Solutions from the initial onsite quotation (Gary) through the pre-installation scheduling/communications (Chloe) and solar system installation (team led by Bryce).

Top job by Luke and his crew. Typical Central Coast tradies - polite, honest, careful and hard working, communicated with me throughout the day. The company is very easy to deal with and also communicates really well with the installation dates, quotes and payments. The system and online app started working the same day and is generating very close to the hourly predictions from Solcast

I needed assistance with my Enphase PV system after Ausgrid disconnected it or turned it off when working on the power pole outside my house.  I was unaware of this until I received an automated message that my system was down.  I contacted All Green and the techie took me through the step by step process to restart the system over the phone.  Without this help I would have been useless.  Great after sales service from this company.
The sales advice was informative providing details related to my existing system and how to improve the value of my solar.
Great pricing.Good customer service.Fast and efficient install.Site cleanup after install.Welcome follow-up call.Recommended. Thanks Finn.
This is the second Enphase system I have purchased From All Green Environmental Solutions and I am impressed. Quality install and Quality products. Thank you.

Great consultation over the phone about our needs and preferences followed by a visit to our house where we further discussed and decided upon the most optimal solar and battery set up. Very polite and knowledgeable conversation with Rick led to our quote the next day. Very reasonable priced 11.4 kWh Trina vertex s+ solar system paired with Tesla Powerwall 3 battery was an easy choice to make.The installation was scheduled and the team came exactly on the same day as organised.In a matter of hours we had everything completed for us for which we were extremely happy about. Credits to Nicholas and his team for the professionalism and their friendly attitude.Best decision we ever made for our electricity  savings as we are almost 97% energy independent since the installation.Also, it’s very promising to have a local company for ongoing support in the future.
Easy to deal with as returning customer, their install of the ev charger was quick and easy. Explained everything need to get started.

Allgreen ticked all the boxes for me:*easy and efficient quoting system*Site visit to iron out siting and sizing issues*easy quote revision following site inspection*No fuss installation, hand-over and followup.System is working well.
All Green were faultless. From the first meeting with the salesperson Rick all the way to handing over the install was such a great experience.The system has been performing brilliantly.

I had 4 quotes - 3 from Solar Quotes. We chose All Green Environmental because they added so much more than the other providers to the quoting process. They offered help and support over the coming weeks as I trawled through my options, prices and systems.It is such a large investment and I feel really confident I chose the right set up for my circumstance. The after care has been phenomenal too, any questions have been dealt with immediately.

From the initial quotation (Powerwall 2) to the consultation process to agree to wait for the release of the Powerwall 3 and some 13.2Kw extra of solar panels, through to the actuall installation the team at All Green did a fantastic job. Any and all question were answered promtly and the team did go out of their way to make the installation as non-intrusive as possible. Explained how to monitor the system in detail and managed to link in the existing solar inverter (SMA) solar production feed such that it show up in the Tesla app. All in all a very good experience
The instillation team and customer service personnel were fantastic. After sales autos also good.

Salesmen fine, got the best system for my house ,great advice, staff reliable and hardworking, they never stop, and completed on time. They did help me with the grid, and spoke directly to them as well. Showed us how to use download which was throughly helpful.

Sales rep assisted with designing a suitable system for an oddly shaped roof and was able to answer all of the questions I had.Installation was quick and the installers were punctual.  The truck was a bit large for the driveway and a few plants were trashed but they will grow back.Grid connection was organised for me.  All I needed to do was to respond to some emails from the energy retailer.

It was a pleasant experience from sales/quoting to the installation. The installation team were fantastic from the beginning to the end with no drama and when completed everything was explained plus the do’s and dont’s. If I asked questions he explained thoroughly to me.I would undoubtedly recommend All Green Enviromental Sollutions.
Quote process was simple and factual.Sales team and back office support is outstanding.Installation team did marvellous job installing 26 panels and 2 batteries professionally.

I have been a long time customer of All Green Environmental Solutions and every interaction is of the same high standard from  Scott and the team.  This time it was to validate issues I was seeing between my solar system and Energy Australia billing.  Scott helped look at the data and provided advice on steps to take in the interim.  I then asked Scott to send out one of the team, Bryce to help do some troubleshooting.  Arrived with minimum fuss and we helped trouble shoot to a faulty HW system.  I have installed solar including an upgrade and since installed a battery.  To quote Molly, 'Do yourself a favour".  Top team, great service and pricing, but what I appreciate the most in the honesty shown by the whole team.If you are looking for someone on the Central Coast do not go past at least picking up the phone and ringing the team

Sales and quoting progressed over a few months and Anthony Lock gave excellent service and feedback at ALL times.         Who ever said installing in a Strata complex has been made simple by the Govt. should be locked up.                                   Installation went smoothly although we had rain on day 1. Dillon arrived ontime and explained they would get started and his leader Nicholas would arrive later due to the rain issue. Nicholas arrived in a moonboot but no problems he toured the site on a scooter and successfully installed the electricals despite the complexity of our two story townhouse structure. We struck an issue with my Trend Micro computer and internet protection which prevented the proper working of the WIFI and the APP but Nicholas got to the bottom of this and we could see the system was working. The project was  finished on the second day and is working very well.

Quote process and quality of technical questions were explained to my understanding.Installation planning was informative and regularly updated.And crew were on time Ange very efficient.Area was constantly kept tidy and all rubbish removed on completion.The electrician Luke stepped me through the phone monitoring process and how the system worked.Follow call from Mark from sales was also informativeColin
Everything was perfect and punctual from the initial sales rep who came out, the quote, installation, and support.They were also the cheapest of all four quotes we had.

Nothing but good things to say regarding All Green. They told me early on that some measures needed to be taken by myself first before I should invest in a solar system. Once that was all sorted and we proceeded with the installation. All Green had a minor mishap that they were honest to me about and completely rectified the situation on their own. Very happy overall.

With so many cheap offers for a battery available right now I decided to go with a good value local supplier and am very satisfied with their response, work and credibility. All their staff were very respectful and knew their business well. Am glad I went with them, even if they were not the cheapest on offer.  Cheap does not always mean best!

Excellent, non-pushy pre sales from Gary.  All my questions were answered.   On the day, Luke and his guys did a fantastic job on a roof that was quite steep.  System producing loads of power.  Very pleased with every aspect of the quoting and installation process.

Whilst not perfect, I had an overall satisfying experience.Their final price I feel was competitive and after doing a fair bit of study and investigation on solar system and differences between suppliers I felt they offered the best overall system and value for money.Only suggestion/criticism would be their follow up and customer after sales experience could improve, which would improve their proposition even more.

Installers were polite but rushed.  I did not get enough answers to my questions but was able to find most information from the internet.  I feel their communication could be much better.  I am still unsure how this system will operate when the grid goes down and given this was the reason I purchased solar, I am disappointed with their instal.
All Green were not the cheapest, but the quality of install and service were great!!
Excellent process at all levels. Honest and upfront team. Competitive price
Very good pre sales service. Very competitive quote. Quality hardware. Installation occurred on the day quoted. No hidden extras. System working perfectly.

Great experience with All Green Environmental Solutions with a recent Enphase Solar system installed. Rick was immensely helpful in the lead up answering all my questions and guiding us to the best solution for our property. Then during the installation period we had great communication, the team were very efficient and tidy. Installed and had us up and running on the same day. Super happy with the end result, definitely recommend them to anyone thinking about going solar.

The whole process was dealt with in a friendly and professional manner.The quoting process was easy and thorough, with all my questions answered fully.The installation was a breeze and again, very professional and completed a very clean and tidy system, including the Tesla Power wall.I had a few questions regarding the battery after installation and they were very willing and happy to assist.The system was up and running by the time they left and I was exporting and reaping the savings straight away.I have not only eliminated my power bills, but now I'm in credit! $540 for the first quarter! I chose to go with Amber as my supplier, accessing wholesale tariffs including feed in. Can't fault the whole process or end product at all.I would fully recommend this local business and the products they install are top quality too.The position of the panels means I get a great output all day and the battery is charged by mid morning (I export the battery to the grid every evening with Amber).

Allgreen was excellent from the start. Rick was informative and helpful with NO pressure consultation, excellent communication from the whole team. The installation process was very smooth. They took away all the mess and there was nothing for me to clean up. Available to assist after sales. They were so good for the first installation that when I moved house I had Allgreen quote and install solar panels and batteries in my new house. Very happy with the process and happy to recommend.

Explained the quotes, very knowledgeable with all of the products that were mentioned.Installation was split due to bad weather, however Bryce and the boys were polite, tidy and punctual.Customer service was fantastic, grid connection,and the app on my phone was assisted and explained to me. Very informative.Happy customers Peter & Janine Summers :)
Quoting process fast and efficient . Date for installation set and kept. Installation performed within 1/2 a day.No mess left .                                          System up and running

Installation took half a day.  No broken tiles or any issues to report.   Installer completed his job better than expected - improved roof lay out of roof panels and more circuits for battery back up than signed in contract as maximum possible.Everything looks very tidy on roof. Quoting process was better than with other 3 potential solar companies, sales person was technically well prepared.  This company was actually the only one who agreed to install Catch Power to feed water heater from solar.  All others referred me to plumbers.  I have to say none of sales people are fully confident and aware how batteries are operating.  My own research was critically important.
Happy with options provided by Mark from Sales. Installation went well, thanks to Luke and his crew. Will definitely engage with this company again for future Solar needs.

From the start, everyone at All Green Environmental Solution have been professional, providing us with all the information that we required to make the best possible decisions.  Mark, the rep was excellent, with supplying the quote, keeping us informed with arrangements and answering any questions that we had. On the day of installation, Bryce and the boys took no time at all installing the Solar Panels, they were polite, took away all reminiscent of our old Solar system and the newsystem was up and running working perfectly.

Easy to work with even after changing my mind a couple of times. Installer professional and on time, very happy with the end result with everything working/performing as expected.No issue recommending, great work!

The sales quoting process was very efficient, and I was kept informed.The installation went smoothly, I was informed of the date and time of installation. I received a reminder the day before and a quick message on the day to say what time they would be here.The team were all very polite and cleared up any mess made.Customer service was helpful, and they did organise the grid connection.I really can't rate the value for money or quality of system as it has only been installed for a week.

The whole process was easy and smooth, from quote to meter changeover, to installation. Install was interrupted by a storm on day one but the boys were rescheduled for the next day and they finshed it off in a couple of hours. All neat and tidy and loving the Enphase monitoring app.

All Green Environmental Solutions provided a great experience in getting a Solar Power solution installed in my home.They took into account my requirements, and provided a very competitive quote.Installation was hassle-free. The system was up and running in half a day. No mess at all.They also took care of contacting my energy provider. So nothing to do on my end in that regard.Very happy with the experience. Highly recommend this company!

The whole process went really well with All Green Environmental Solutions.They contacted me straight away and I spoke to the salesperson 3 or 4 times over 4 or 5 days just to make sure I was going to get the right system for me.The salesperson was very helpful and sent me some quotes with a few different systems and options.He was not pushy at all.I paid the deposit and a date was set for installation.The wait for installation was about 6 weeks,but I think that there would be a similar wait at the moment if you got someone else.They organised a new meter to be installed and contacted the Electrical Company.I wasn't required to do anything.The date of the installation wasn't changed and they let me know the day before that they were coming.The installation went well with no problems.All the installers were polite and did a good job.The system looks good and neat.Then Luke helped me get the phone app and connected it to the system.I am really happy with everything from start to finish.The system was installed 2 weeks ago and I am happy with what the panels are producing so far.

After researching what I wanted and how to take advantage of solar I sent my requirements to several companies, Mark responded promptly and patiently answered all my questions and provided me with a comprehensive breakdown of my options and outlined the process. He was always very quick to respond to any questions I had and gave his real world experience with a similar system. Luke and the boys rocked up ahead of time and despite the poor weather did what they could, they returned 2 days later to install the panels and were very efficient and didn't leave until ensuring all panels were reporting in the app. The Enphase tech accidentally reset my grid profile and Mark/Scott both responded very quickly to rectify the problem, and were very patient when there were issues with my network security blocking the updates. It's now correctly producing as per what was installed. Communication, service, support and performance has been great, cannot recommend them and the system highly enough.

We finally had our Tesla battery installed to our existing solar system after some delays, not the installer fault, there were just none available when the order was placed.The install went exactly to plan, they arrived on time and firstly gave us a full rundown of how everything would be completed.The install took around 5 hours from the start until it was fully operational.Once installed, they tested the system fully and explain each point and how everything worked. They helped me set up the monitoring app and answered any questions.The whole process was easy from Solar Quotes arranging the quotes, the quotes coming back quickly and placing my order.Would 100% recommend All Green Environmental Solutions, great install and service from start to finish.

Rick from All Green Environmental Solutions was knowledgeable, patient, friendly and polite and always returned calls from us promptly whilst we were still deciding which company to go with and which system to have installed. He provided us with good advice and we are very happy with the system and the energy it is producing, even on overcast days. The installers were punctual, polite and completed a difficult job cheerfully - it was a very windy, hot day, we have a two storey house, and had 28 panels installed. The office staff were always helpful and prompt with sending out paperwork, etc. It was a pretty seamless experience.

Received a proactive quote before having to provide any details. Price was immediately competitive without negotiating. They specified the right equipment based on quality and price (I spent hours comparing options from various suppliers and what they proposed up front was very sensible). Installers were highly qualified with good comms skills. I have a complicated house - no extra charges or surprises. This was all around a positive experience for a fairly complex process.

Excellent advice given with absolutely no pressure from sales person. I received a quote straight away and had a comfortable feeling I was dealing with true professionals who took care of the installation exactly how they said they would. The install crew were punctual, pleasant and did a great job.
Yes I have purchased a solar system from one of your recommended installers.  But their lead time is over two months.  So I look forward to installation happening in early November.

Sales/quoting process: No issues, had to go back and forward a few times to tweak when we pointed out the amount of shade but that was handled fine.Installation: No issues on the day, I didn't receive the first notification of the date of install, issue with email presumably, so was a bit of a rush to arrange for rubbish disposal (removal of old solar pool heating system) and spare tiles for the terracotta tiled roof.  Spare tiles turned up a day after the install, they came back and replaced the few cracked/moved tiles without issue.Customer Service: Very good, grid connection was already organised etc.Overall a good install and system appears to be working well with the sun starting to come out.

Fantastic experience and highly recommended.. from the first call to the actual installation, everybody was friendly,  polite,  available to talk and happy to share information.The installers were friendly and polite.  They explained what they were doing,  made sure I was happy with where components were going and did a great job.Overall, fantastic experience and would recommend to anybody looking to get solar.

It is only early days since our new solar system was installed but overall I am extremely impressed by All Green Environmental Solutions. From my first phone call to get a quote, through to the follow up after the installation, the service is first rate. Any questions I had were addressed and you actually felt like a valued customer, something that is rare these days. I cannot recommend these guys highly enough and a special shout out to Mark for his help through the process.

Installed on 14 Aug 2023. Too soon to comment on quality/effectiveness,etc. Installation crew was efficient, even though they broke 2 roof tiles. AGL scheduled to change meter next week. Thanks for Finn Peacock service in recommending 3 solar providers.

Fantastic.Rick called when he said he would, drew up multiple quote options for me based on different scenarios and answered all of my questions in a way that I could understand not coming from that industry of background.
Selling/quoting goodInstallation punctual and tidy, but stalled for a week just before connecting for reasons not adequately expainedConnection left to me so I am following up

Great panels with integrated Micro Inverters, good price & excellent installation - very neat & tidy!The quoting process was simple and straight forward - very flexible as things changed.Installation took place quietly & efficiently, and left the work areas tidy & clean.Customer Service was good, and they appeared a couple of days later without being asked, just to check things were going well! Five Stars!

The quote was on-time, friendly and met our requirements.The installation was programmed, punctual, polite and effective.All the paperwork and approvals were timely and there was no difficulty in organising the grid connection.

The response to my initial enquiry for a quote was very prompt, as were responses to my enquiries for details on placement etc. The installers were very professional. I was informed of arrival time with text messages etc. Installers on site were prompt and very tidy. Very happy with the system and the installation.

The company was good to deal with and the work and workmanship was very good, we do have a problem with the installation and are talking to them about it. as required by Local Govt. we have to catch rain water for washing and toilets, all the quotes used Google earth to view the site for cell installation rather than visiting and measuring so that when they fixed the mounting rails to the roof,  it became apparent that cells on both sides overhung the guttering such that we would catch very little water on these 2 sides, which feed our main tank. I have asked if they can move the cells further up the roof 50 to 100 mm and they are looking into it.I know it would add to their costs but visiting site3s and taking actual measurements would have avoided this problem.
Onsite quote, knowledgeable installation team to make important minor adjustments on the day. A very good experience.

Excellent advice and service all-round. Quote was comprehensive and no problems when changes were made. Installation was as per the agreed date and time and post installation explanation was excellent. Would have no hesitation in recommending All Green Environmental Services and Mark Seeman the main contact point I worked with

Easy as process. Nice Sales people.We had to post-pone installation date a couple of times due to other repairs on my house. Was never a problem.On the day - they Turned up as promised. On time. They explained what they'll be doing, where panels will go, what each component is and does. Cleaned up when finished.Bryce (Electrician) registered everything via an app. And system was connected and running same day.Paperwork for Energy provider came through a couple of days later - just waiting on AusGrid now to update the meter.
Nil issues with installing or explanation of app but we are still organising updates on grid connections ourselves

Great experience from start to finish. Sales person was extremely helpful and put up with me changing designs multiple times and settling on a design to maximise my limited roof space. Nil pressure from them.Installers arrived on time on the day they were supposed to. They were very helpful at working with me to ensure that they did theor best to install to my design requirements. This meant a difficult install on three different orientations over three different levels. We had 1st storey tiled garage facing west, 2nd storey tiled main roof facing south, second storey tiled main roof facing north, and ist storey back veranda on colourbond facing north.The battery had to be installed on on the side of the house along a narrow pathway. Did their best to place the battery high enough so that we could still move bins, mowers, etc past without hitting it.The install team were also very polite and left the place looking like they had never been there.

All staff were helpful and friendly. The installation was quick and went smoothly.They helped with info for the grid connection after install.Got a discount for display a sign in my yard - the sign is not an eyesore.
Thank you guys at Allgreen in relocating the inverter from a north facing wall to inside the garage wall.

Easy quoting process. They provided 3 options, we picked the best one for our needs. They helped set us up with finance, arranged installation. Installers were friendly and helpful, answering all our questions. Would recommend

They came when they said they would and were efficient with installation. They also replaced broken tiles for me and even went and got extra spare tiles for this.Everything was left nice and clean afterwards.

All green environment solutions was quick on response. Very good no frills system. All workers were very polite. need, tidy. On time on install date, very happy with install, waiting on first power bill to see difference.

Overall, I was fairly happy with the service. Friendly, not too pushy, good communicators which is important to me, and that can be said for both the sales team and installers. My only criticism is that they failed to consider a whirlybird on the roof during the planning, so when it came to install the panels were not put in the most ideal place. I think more consideration would have lead to a more efficient system.

Found them easy to deal with from initial sales contact. Happy to entertain my questions to the point I decided to commit.Really friendly installation crew. Obliging with some minor requests I made at the installation today.As the installation, I trust that the company will follow through with submitting the necessary paperwork to my electricity provider.

The company did exactly what it promised to do. The installation was done in about 5 hours and was very efficient. They quickly organised all the connections and very quickly my system was generating sufficient power to make me on average 90% independent of the grid. All in all a great experience

The quoting process was good and the installation was punctual and tidy which is something that pleases me. One of the main reasons for choosing them was the quality level of the panels and inverter for my price range. I just wish they were more involved with the grid connection than I've had to be. I can't yet comment on the performance as the grid connection hasn't been completed but so far I'm very happy with the process.
Polite, tidy and punctual although our neighbour complained about some roof litter that landed on their property

From the quote to the installation, everything was professional and done to a high standard. Communication was excellent. This is the second Solar install from All Green for us, this one being for our second property. We have had good performance from our existing system and so were happy to use All Green for this installation. Being a Local company is also an advantage.
Quote provided on time as offered, punctual install  and hassle free, all work completed on time including bluetooth grid access introduction and explanation.Overall well done.

From the initial contact and discussions over system options and their respective merits, through to the decision making process and to installation, the team at All Green Environmental Solutions were very helpful and friendly.  I was never made to feel pushed down a particular path and as AGES are a locally based company with years of service to the local market, I felt that I could trust their advise and expertise. Thanks team, I look forward to years of trouble free solar.
Excellent from start to finish. Professional and friendly. A great team - we are very happy.
Sales and quoting process was greatInstallation was easy and the team was neat and tidyFinancing options were easy and They helped through the process

All Green Environmental Solutions came highly rated for customer service on Solar Quotes, and they lived up to the reputation with their communication, friendliness and support through the installation process. When quoting, they took the time to understand my circumstances and develop an appropriate system for my needs. On the day of installation they were able to accommodate my change in availability without fuss.

Happy with the systems suggested by 3 suppliers but went with the one that better suited what we needed. Five week wait for install but that allowed us to do our meter swap first. Install guys were punctual and polite and the job was completed as per the schedule despite some rain interruption. Just wish I hade been given the installers info on the day so I could organize the grid connection. In fact it would have been better if I actually had the form I needed.System working well and from day two we have satisfied our electrical needs purely from what we have generated and stored.
Great communication and Super Installers with all the information. I could not fault this team.

All Green Environmental were the only ones that rang and challenge my requests instead of offering me the battery I was after. Rick suggested I change the whole system as technology may not be compatible. This made a lot of sense as if you went from a different brand and 10 years older - there will be gaps. When he quoted me what a whole new system was going to cost - pretty much went for it.The install guys were awesome. Showed up on time and helped with replacing broken tiles. Perfect manners and they cleaned up very well after themselves. I have nothing but good things to say about them.One thing that I should point out was the emails with their admin - most didn't reply. Although Rick was answering emails during the Xmas break. Having said that it was no big deal the admins didn't answer, maybe my emails went to their SPAM. I don't know.

Good sales experience and information, competitive price, Australian made panels, installation on time, great install team who were helpful, tidy & courteous. Customer service very good with follow up & information. Overall a good experience.

The people at All Green Environmental Solutions were fantastic from the get go. Being a novice to the PV world, they gave me plenty of options and sound advice on what was best for my circumstances.They came and installed the system on the day they advised they would. And gave me a run down on how to use the app that came with.After care service was great with them answering any ongoing questions I had.Will definitely recommend and use them again when I decide to install a battery.

We had many questions following the initial quote and found the sales team happy to answer all our questions patiently and respectfully. They followed up with an amended quote based on our preferences. All Green Solutions stood out in their willingness to discuss and meet our needs rather than sell us an inflexible packaged system. The communication, installation, grid connection and software support was excellent. It is now 9 months since installation and we couldn't be happier. We will use All Green Solutions again when we add a battery to the system in the future.

Sale/Quoting process was fast and online. Easy to compare and also easy to choose with multiple options.Installation was 2 months after the sale as the guys are super busy.One day of installation, everything was done and dusted quickly and efficiently.Apps (Tesla and Enphase) were explained once everything was connected and up and running.Very happy with the system so far.

Joel was very helpful in listening to what I wanted and provided a great range of quotes. Speaking with him he didn't try and up sell me to a more expensive option and answered my many questions.Installation went extremely well. Bryce and his team were punctual, quick and tidy. Removing my old system and installing the new one in 5hrs. Bryce went through the system and app, then climbed back on the roof to adjust a couple of panels for me.The system has been working beyond expectations.  The only small concerning issue was being contacted the day before installation informing me that they couldn't install the Jinko panels as originally quoted (no stock). I found this interesting seeing as the deposit had been paid over a month before. The pannels where substituted with what I was told a better Aus made pannel with double the warranty. Time with tell with these pannels.Overall very happy with All Green and recommend them.

AGES is an excellent solar provider company from sales, right to installation, and aftersales. Gary was very patient during quoting stage, with numerous options provided from standard string systems to the latest tech. Also, he took it in his stride with the panels layout being changed a few times and non-stop quesitons. Alas, no thanks to the lockdown, installation was postponed close to 2 months. But the wait was not in vain, as the panels was sort of upgraded from 370W to 440W due to availability but maintaining the overall systems total of 6.6kW.Installation was very smooth with Wayne and his 2 apprentices texting their arrival time and really arrived very punctually. By 2 pm, the whole system was up and running. Wayne guided me on the app usage and the team left the place in as clean a condition as it was before. After install, within a day, AGES provided the necessary paperwork for submission to my energy retailer. It's now exactly 2 weeks since install, and I got my first electricity bill. Absolutely stoke with the bill reduction and looking forward to many years of savings. Thanks AGES !Cheers!Vic

Installer's Longevity in the Business - I went to ASIC to make sure how long the installer have been in business for6. Installer's Performance - I used Solar Quotes reviews, Google Reviews, and TrustPilot Reviews to get a balanced view of the installer's performance.7. After sales service - This is harder to determine as not much data apart from what the Installer offers.I told each installer to give me their best system and their 2nd best system so I ended up comparing 10 quotes across  5 installers.  I gave each Selection Criteria a Weight and multiplied them against the score that I gave for each selection criteria so I ended up getting the quote from the installer with the highest Weighted Average which came out as All Green,The Sales People from all 5 companies were quite forthcoming in giving me the information I need, including 1 company whose salesperson keeps on pressuring me to make a decision (fortunately not the All Green Sales person).The Install Team was even better.  They came early.  And the team lead, David Smith, was excellent.  He answered all my concerns including:1. How the microinverters will be connected to my 3-phase power via a Trunk Cable that allows each microinverter output to be connected in a round-robin way to Phase A, Phase B, and Phase C so the whole setup delivers 3-phase power in a balanced way.2. How the cables will come down to my meter box in a neat way.  I've included a picture of my meter box beside the Solar Switches and you won't see any wires between them.  David did a good job of dropping the cables through the brickwork cavity so looking from the outside the wires just disappeared.3. How they will insure no rain water leaks getting into my roof.  They had to drill holes in some of my tiles to pass through the Trunk Cable output from the microinverters.  But they sealed that with a contraption that will ensure no water leaks come in the house.  David only asked for 1 tile replacement on the top roof so not a lot of tile breakages.  I actually had to buy 10 spares apart from my 20 spares of roof tiles which I have under the house but they were not needed,  So far no water leakages have been detected, and we've had decent rain already.David's Team came around 8:30 am and were finished by 2:30 pm.  David stayed back to show me how the monitoring system works.  He also discussed how I can move my water heating which currently happens between midnight and 5am to sometime during the day so I make maximum use of solar power.  David's team also cleaned up and brought all rubbish with them.  I was amazed that all my worries disappeared and it was really a walk in the park thanks to All Green's install team.I would totally recommend them to anyone who wants to install a topnotch system with no install hitches.After we paid the balance of the install, we got the necessary paperwork (CCEW) to apply to Energy Australia for a changeover of our meter to a 3-Phase net meter.  Energy Australia has its own application form for the changeover so all we had to do was submit the CCEW and the Energy Australia application form, and within 3 weeks we have been scheduled for a meter changeover.  As of the time of this writing, we will get the new meter in a week's time.

Following installation, I have called the lead electrician with questions on two occasions and he has happily helped out. The company did not provide any assistance with grid connection and it took several calls and emails before I was sent the necessary paperwork to effect the new meter installation...and when the paperwork was initially sent, it was for another customer.

Good service, smooth installation. Knowledgeable salesperson.  Emberpulse system provides good monitoring from phone or PC. Pity the government doesn't get energy companies to give a 1:1 return on energy I give them as some States do in USA.

I am very impressed by your company.  It was highly recommended to me by two friends, unknown to each other.From the first contact with Russell, who answered all of My questions and queries.David and his install crew were fantastic.  He was punctual and got the job done in no time.  His crew are a credit to your organisation.  They were organised and polite and tidied up after themselves.  It was refreshing to see a group of young workers so enthusiastic.In the few days that the PV solar has been connected, I am very pleased with the harvest, more than I expected for this time of year.Overall, I am very pleased with your organisation and have no hesitation in recommending you to all of my contacts who are interested in Solar.

We have had all green do 3 jobs for us. First a 6kw solar install.  sales guy was super relaxed and not pushy.  just answer questions i had, straight to the point. Unlike the other companies that quoted and forced me to go through mountains of paperwork to calculate return on investment. Second install was a powerwall 2, which went perfectly and last week we had a further 8kw system (23 panels) and another power 2 installed. Both of these were done in 4 hours and everything was up and running, these guys are insanely good at what they do. Everything is working as advertised. Definitely recommend these guys.

Knowledgeable sales person - first question asked was "how long do you intend to stay here" followed by "what is your objective with solar"?The quote was tailored to suit our needs and specified budget - he came out to inspect the roof and noted where the sun was and ended up suggesting an Enphase micro-inverter system, which allowed 2 north facing arrays and an array on the Western side of the roof to catch the afternoon sun.  This would ensure plenty of generation for a big air conditioner between 2-4pm (hottest time of the day). Enphase was also flexible and future proofed our investment (easy to add panels later and the forthcoming isolating switches will allow solar to run off grid in the event of a grid black out).  We are also waiting on the new Enphase high amp batteries to come out (3kw and 6kw due out next year).  They were flexible with dates (the first scheduled day was rained out so they rescheduled promptly), the installation was quick and professional - system is working fine (I can monitor performance on the laptop or phone) and it's now a case of getting reduced power bills come the next quarter.And the icing on the cake - we paid for JA panels (which are tier 1), but there were no in the country when it came time to install.  So that we wouldn't get delayed they upgraded us to the (slightly more expensive) Trina tier 1 panels at no extra cost.  I can't say they will do this for everyone, but it was a great bonus.

We had personal recommendations from two families in our area who had both used ALLGREEN and they both could not speak more highly of the service and the quality of their installations.  We opted, like of friends, to install Enphase micro inverters with the JINKO JKM330M-60 panels.  38 panels in total have been installed to north & western tiled roof planes at 22 degrees same as roof.  Before accepting their Quote, we obtained Warranties for the racking, the panels and the Enphase system.

Great sales process, patient  with all my questions, very responsive and honest.  Installation was a excellent. SMS notifications days before to reconfirm date, SMS on morning with installer name and to say he was on way.  Installation was per the initial plan, very tidy (can't see any cabling) and very symmetrical on the roof. APP was set up fast and easy to use to monitor.  All in all, a VERY positive experience by the team. Communicative, courteous and left the place spotless.

The salesman was pleasant and informative but not at all pushy.Installation went well they sent an sms to say they were on their was (which was good because they were much earlier than expected). They were polite and efficient. Left no mess. Gave us concise instructions on how to download and use their tracking software. They were finished and gone in 6 hours.Customer service so far has been great. As we already have a smart meter we are just waiting for the paperwork so that we can claim our feed in tariff from our providerThanks Finn for your help

The team arrived when they said they would and were utterly professional throughout. They even installed the inverter in the garage for me rather than next to the meter. My only criticism, and it is a small one, is that it can be sometimes hard to get hold of someone in the office. They are super busy. However once you do get hold of someone, they are able to answer any questions.
The online quoting was quick and efficient, and communication was v effective.Installation was very good and done with no fussGrid connection and paperwork completed by All Green the same day
All Green Environmental Solutions staff were great.  No misleading information, just simple facts and they listened to what I wanted.
Very responsive to my multiple questions during the quoting process (due to shading considerations), and provided excellent supplementary information.  Professional Installation and Customer Service.

I found the whole experience seeking a provider through your website to be a tremendous help. You nominated three very reputable companies, who all gave prompt quotes and were all very helpful. These providers also offered a wide range in pricing and apparent quality of components. One company dealt mainly with top-end components which were very expensive but no doubt industry leading technology, but the cost was well over my budget. The other two were quite competitive offering similar quality gear, so I chose the lower quote. I was also grateful for your feedback to some of my questions regarding quality etc, and this gave me more confidence that I still chose well above average quality equipment. I now have my 7.5 kW system installed, with 15 panels on the northern side and 10 panels on the western side of our house, due to roof space restrictions etc. In the last week, my system has produced over 30 kWh for each of 6 days, all of which were sunny with no clouds. On a cloudy day it produced 18 kWh. These are very pleasing results for the middle of July! I am also impressed with the real-time digital reporting app. I am overall very happy with the installation company, and would recommend them without hesitation.

I don't normally write reviews but decided to do it for All Green as I had a great experience and smooth transaction with them.Joe on the sales end was really great with understanding the needs and providing analysis for couple of different scenarios. He didn't try to push me to sell the biggest system and provided the optimum one that'd suite my need.It took a while to get it installed, but Wayne and the crew was great on the day. They had all the equipment and didn't even have to come inside the house. They did all the work from outside which was great as I was working from home that day. The job was neat and I didn't have to a tidy up after they've left.Emma and Kylie in the office were great to deal with as well.The system is working like a charm and automatically shut down safely when there was planned maintenance in the electricity network.Thanks guys, couldn't have been a smoother transaction. I'll be recommending you to everyone who's considering solar
Very punctual the installation went easy thanks to David very professional and polite
Installation to happen 10/7. So far so good

Sales process was professional with site visit to clarify details. The sales person believed the installation team could place 3 arrays on the north facing roof. This was based on near maps photo of roof.Installation team were polite, punctual, tidy and arrived on the agreed date.Installation team found that 3 Arrays would not fit well on the north facing roof and recommended an alternative solution which was agreed with me.I have Terracotta tiles on the roof and I recommend that Customers have spare tiles available in case an Installer breaks a tile.I organised the grid connection with information provided by the Installer. They helped me promptly when I had questions in relation to this.

All Green Environmental Solutions offered a good design at a competitive price. The sales quote was comprehensive and the person in charge of the installation was courteous. Also the office staff was great to deal with. Would definitely recommend this company.

Very detailed and thorough, provided quotes for many different configurations with different quality levels of hardware. Installation team turned up within 10 minutes of stated time (calling earlier to inform they were on the way). They were reasonably tidy (some loose bits of packaging around), and very polite. They constantly updated me on progress and spoke to me about a slight configuration change due to difficulties around my whirlybird. After the install, they sent documents within 1-2 business so I could organise getting my meter updated. I needed to call to confirm some details and they were happy to reply.
Neat and tidy. Polite. Excellent service. Very smooth installation. Very happy with the final product

No pressure quotes, offering different solar options depending on your budget if you know what you want. Good pre-sales advice offered.  You have to get a few other quotes to compare pricing.  Installation went smoothly but they had to come back to put in the last panel.  Wayne was great - knowledgeable, came on time, completed the job efficiently and left the place tidy. Certification was provided promptly on receipt of payment.  Now waiting for energy retailer to install the smart meter.

Great experience from start to finish. I knew nothing about solar but after reading your website and asking questions and speaking with Anne from Green Solar about different panels and inverters I then made my choice. Installers Richard and Henry went above and beyond in their duty of care, work ethics, manners and help. Amazing pair.

Hi Finn,The solar panels will be installed next week so I am unable to make many comments at this stage. I don't know how long it will take afterwards before the system is fully operational. I suggest you contact me again after a month or so to see how things are going. I am not expecting very much at first because we are approaching the time of year when we have the lowest period of daylight hours.Regards,Maria
All very professional and friendly, left very clean and tidy, information clear
System and pricing was what we had hoped for. Communication between buyer and seller could be a lot better with regards to seller not replying to calls and messages in timely manner.
reviews.panel_brand: Unsure of brand currently on cruise to New Zealand (Other)

reviews.review_description: From sales, who explained the difference in systems, to customer service, who provided all we needed with intrusion, to our installer, who was punctual polite and helpful. Combined they provided a seamless experience I wouldn't hesitate in recommending.

We were very happy to find a decent quality 7.5kW system (6kW SMA inverter, 7.48kW of Canadian Panels) for $5000. The extra $300 was for a meter board upgrade. All the other quotes we we received were either for lower quality budget systems or much more expensive high quality systems. On top of that the customer service was good and the installers very helpful. We were really pushing to fit 26 panels on our difficult roof and they ended up making it look easy.
Easy to deal with and the installer did a great job.

Sale person offered customer focus service. Listened to customer enquiries and replied questions promptly.Assisted to tailor the best solar system to our requirements and provided several solution options.Installation persons came on-site on the promised day at the appointed time. They are nice and efficient. The technical installer explained solar monitoring system to us in details. Site was cleaned up tidily afterwards.Documents were promptly received after installation and payment. They advised procedure to obtain grid connection.Overall, a good performance company for solar installation.

The installation was booked in, and the installers showed up at the agreed time - sadly not the case with all companies I have worked with, so that was a good first impression! Communication about the install date and time was good - so no complaints at all from me!Installation was done in one day, and I was walked through the monitoring app, with plenty of opportunity to ask questions.Unfortunately one component was missing, preventing the storage battery from being operational. This was resolved within a few days, so didn't cause any issues for us. No payment was requested until the entire installation was completed.I am happy with the performance of the system, and I am very happy with the team who did the actual install.I would certainly recommend All Green to anyone looking to install solar.

It is easy to see why All green has got such a high rating from their clients. Starting from the quote system, the professionalism was evident. The quote included not just the pricing but the technical details of the proposed solution as well. This helps the client to take a more informed decision. Also if you want another configuration, they are not hesitant to send you another quote in seconds. You can configure the elements you need in your installation through the online quote and place the order online too. They are willing to come to your home for a face to face discussion as well.After confirming the order, they informed us about the installation date. Before the date a text message confirmed the installation. They were punctual and ready to work, even if it was a 40C day. They did a professional job and the system was commissioned successfully. They cleared up all left-overs from the installation.After the install and my finalizing of the payment, they send me all the documents for my electricity supplier.All in all, a job well done!!
Only issue was their lack of knowledge and support in assisting me with Smart meter application and installation.
After service was a little problematic, no one answer the phone and took days later before I hear from them.

The sales and quote process was easy. As this was the last of 5 quotes, I had the benefit of asking Russell the nuances and different approaches that each company, it became clear that All Green had a wealth of experience installing many panels. Russell was able to explain the pros and cons of each approach. There was good communication throughout the process.David and his installation team was polite, on time and efficient. I particularly appreciated that he took care to route the cabling carefully, keeping the exterior of the house as neat as possible. I picked All Green because they have their own employees and not sub contractors. Should a problem arise there is only one party responsible for fixing it. It is early days yet and so have I haven't had to test the after sales service.

There was quite a long lead time from deposit to installation. And weather also got in the way. Generally speaking the installation was mostly incident free. The positioning of the panels had to be modified because the satellite picture isn't accurate enough to place panels on a tight roof area correctly. The installers were very good and worked a good compromise. I would recommend this company.

All sales people were polite.The All Green Environmental Solutions team were first rate. Quick and efficient.The installation certificates were sent to me and I organised the new smart meter with my energy supplier.
All good, whole process went well from start to finish.
Very helpful & friendly installers prompt service
2 suggested installers didn't contact me at all. The other started off well but lost me through poor comms. So I went with AllGreen. However I researched them through your excellent site.

The company provided 3 separate options and quotes which allowed us to consider our options.  The installers arrived on time, installed the system efficiently and provided a good briefing on the system itself.  We did have to chase up the final paperwork after paying the final amount but this was provided very quickly so that we could organise with our electricity provided to have a new meter installed (this is taking longer than we expected but anticipated to be installed by the end of the month).

Joe the sales person was polite, courteous answered and explained all questions I had, also showed me the system app for laptop or mobile to monitor the progress and export of energy.  Scott and his team were a happy team on time and got stuck into the install. Couldn't be happier.

Quoting system great, provided a range of options (with prices). Responded quickly to our questions. Installers were efficient, reliable and provided detailed information when asked. We've only had the system for a week but we're really pleased with it, our 5 kW system is making about 35 kW a day.
Always turned up on time. Keep me informed where they were at.

Early days, but very positive so far. Russell made a site visit and answered all my questions. He did not over promise, which made me feel I could trust him. He was happy to take follow-up calls. I accepted the quote for the slightly more expensive Enphase system with micro-inverters as this seemed worth paying for. They installed within 2 weeks. Installation process was flawless with very pleasant and efficient installers. Haven't had my first bill yet but the easy to use app shows exactly how much we're producing and using throughout the day.

AGES did a great job overall.  The quoting process went well without pressure from the company to make a sale.  The company had a wide range of panels available and appeared to provide non bias, objective information on the systems they had on offer and those of their competitors.  The installation went well on the day and their tradesmen left our house clean without rubbish left behind.  I'd recommend AGES for a solar installation.
Sales process was quick with plenty of options. The installation all done and working in one day.Installers were polite and punctual.

We have loved working with All Green Environmental Solutions, right from the very start from when they first contacted me they were happy to work with us to our budget, after many hours reading as much as I could on your pages Finn about various Panels, Inverters, Micro inverters and so on we ultimately decided to go with the 300W Suntech panels with Enphase S270 Micro inverters. Wolf Messthaler the sales Rep from All Green Environmental Solutions answered every question we had, he even gave us a few things to think about and to research, there was never any pressure to sign up or to buy from them, when we did decide to go ahead they arrived on the morning they said they would, Joel and the others who installed the system was a great bloke, he explained things to my brother as I was not able to be there on the day, he also rang me and walked me through the various features of the monitoring app. From our dealings with them they have been extremely professional, happy to answer any questions we had and a absolute pleasure to work with, we have only had this system working for 10 days but so far on average we are producing 28kw of power each day even on the two very cloudy days that we have had we still produced 22kw on each of those two days. From our experience I would highly recommend All Green Environmental Solutions

All Green Environmental Solutions were great to deal with.They were happy to discuss the solar products and services in easy to understand language.  As we discussed certain aspects of the system, I required a number of quotes to reflect the different size system we were discussing at the time, and they were always happy to assist.The installation went very smoothly and the installation team were polite and professional. They turned up on time and left the site clean and tidy.  They demonstrated the system and walked me through the enlighten program before they left.  I have called them a couple of times since the install with a couple of questions and they have been happy to help out.As far as organising the grid connection after the install, they have been pretty hand off on this point.  They provided all the required documentation that I then provided to the energy company, so I am not quite sure what additional benefits they can add to this process.All in all, my experience has been very positive and I would be happy to recommend All Green Environmental Solutions.

AGES provided the most thorough answers to all of my numerous post-quote questions via email (my preferred method of contact). The installation was arranged for my requested date and was completed with minimal fuss. I had a small issue the following day that I reported and it was politely and efficiently fixed the same day. I wouldnâ€™t hesitate to recommend this company to others interested in installing solar and Iâ€™m very happy with the micro-inverters assisting with our partial morning shading.
Very pleased with All Green Environmental solutions advise & given alternative cheaper options.  Installed same day & no follow up issues ,
Sales rep was very knowlegeable . Designed the correct size and style of system we needed. Installation team were professional and on time.

Wolf in sales was helpful and always answered my questions. Installation was completed in no time at all in mid Feb 2019, Wayne and Lucas left no mess. had a lot of rain since then and no leaks in roof. Very satisfied with system and workmanship.

All Green Environmental Solutios is one of the most professional, caring and efficient companies I have ever dealt with.The installation team was very prompt, quick, and obviously enjoyed their work. They were amiable and happily explained what was happening and what to expect from my systemNothing but praise for this company.

They came out to my home, measured roof area, checked existing power supply, discussed and explained different solar systems. single dc inverter vs 30 x microinverters. A very knowledgeably sales person.Answered all my questions and provided actual facts and figures of similar installations nearby for me to look at. The installation is due to be finished on the 17th September (unfortunately rain stopped installation being finished on the date agreed to). Very polite, neat and tidy tradesmen beautiful work.
Down to earth knowledgeable salesman, efficient friendly installation.  The panels are producing in excess of my current needs.
Sales were very helpful,  they knew the products well.The installation team was great, quick efficient and cleaned up nicely.

After a couple of series of reviews and research earlier in the year, we set about a determined process to get solar installed before Spring. Navigating the various products, solutions and quotes is a challenging process, to I used a spreadsheet and weighted ranking system to help keep track of what I had received, from who, what panels, what inverters, rebates, install, software etc. This really helped to focus the decision. Each to their own.It came down to a couple of suppliers, offering different systems (micro-inverters or single inverter). Both worked hard for our business and it came down to a superior quote for a 9kW enphase system that won in the end.Dealing with Russell was fairly easy. He was pretty direct and open about the various products and had good sound advice to help focus the system we chose. His ferrari and datsun analogies were great!!From paying the deposit to the install date, was a little over 2 weeks. This is great after the whole process and paying good money.The install team (6 guys) arrived when they said they would and set to work straight away. I worked from home, so the consultation and explanation process was pretty easy. I recommend it as you get what you want that way. All of the guys were friendly, tidy and worked around the dogs.The commissioning of the system was pretty simple as well, being up and running not long after lunch once the final panels went up. They left the site clean and the installation work looked neat and of a high standard.All Green provided the permit and certificate promptly after the final payment. This allowed me to book in the upgrade from a gross meter (old system) to a net meter. That process is roughly 10BD from contacting the solar team (AGL). You need to be patient in this time as you will be exporting energy back to the grid, but not getting the FiT for it. I wish that you could submit an application once you know the install date and have it happen the day after.Overall it was a good process with All Green and we are happy with our system. I can't recommend the Enphase monitoring software enough. As an electrical engineer, it is VERY interesting. We have used it to change our consumption and should help us drive cost down further.I would recommend them. In fact we agreed to have their sign out the front, to take a little bit more off the price....

Good communication and prompt response to rectify minor damage to existing wiring due to installation in back of switchboard.Awaiting solution to problems with Enphase Enlighten monitoring software fault indication.

All Greens Tricha was so helpful, and not pushy like some of the other companies , Solar was only installed last week and i can already see how much solar i am making and exporting through the app on my phone. I would recommend this company to anyone . I already had a 3kw system installed 5 years ago, that was never installed correctly and had never worked, so over $10,000 down the drain ( installed by Planet Solar Care, known as Array Energy), but All Green took down the useless system at no cost to me. Solar Quotes is the only way to go. they offered 3 x quotes from qualified,reputable businesses, so you dont have to deal with all the unreputable ones.

had a small delay with insillation due to unforseen problem with installer ( death in family) but  was kept informed all way through and installed in 1 day and up and working straight away, paperwork came that night in an email, so onto energy supplier next day now still awaiting new meter
Fantastic professional team on the day of the install.  Lead up communication was excellent and they were the only company that listened to my needs and priced a good product. Highly recommend

Our system was an expansion of a five year old PV system, so that we now have 8kw and an LG 9.6 kWh battery.  Installation has been complicated and will have taken over a month. They have been co-operative and generous.

Salesman was great and explained a lot, listened to my concerns . Install went well. Good guys, quick, polite, relatively tidy, explained changes. There was delay in releasing paperwork for me to get smart meters until cheque cleared. Not happy to be treated as if it will not clear. Communication could be better. System was not performing as I expected  - 8kW system flatlining at 5kW. Left messages & texts with installer who had left me his card. No reply. Finally phoned office last week and issue apparently fixed. They had configured our system to be limited to 5kW!  Aside from that, great system and monitoring tool. Would now (that I understand the issue with limiting system) recommend the company. Monitoring app has been updated to give detailed info and helped me to determine that i actually had a problem rather than just higher expectations of the system.
Trish was very helpful on the phone and she knew what she was talking about and was not pushy. They provided the system I wanted at a better price than the competition.

Hi FinnYour site was very helpful and informative which made researching a lot easier, Scott and the team from All Green Environmental Solutions did a great job and would have no hesitation recommending them. Regards to you and your Team. Wal Edwards
Nice clean installation all done in less than a day; was generating electricity within 4 hours of the installation starting.So far so good.

The installation was completed very quickly and with no hassles once we decided to go ahead. I love the Enlighten app that comes with the system that allows you to see how much power you are using and how much the solar array is producing at any time. The biggest headache has been trying to get our meter changed with our energy supplier. I would have liked more help with that part of the process from All Green.
Was good, chose the most proactive supplier, great installation team
Communication not a super strong point at times, but quality and price got All Green over the line.

Amazing service and installation from All Green. From the first point of contact they were extremely helpful in explaining all the different types of solar systems and the pros and cons of each. Prior to the day of installation I got SMS notifcations not to forget about the installation and expected time of arrival, I even got a SMS from the installer letting me know he was on his way. The installation team were very friendly and professional in the way they handled the job and all the cabling. I am so glad I went with All Green even if it was a little bit more than my other quotes due to the fact they had their own installers and sales team. The sale representative even visited the site on a Sunday and spoke to us rather than just phone and email conversations.

The All Green Environmental electricians were able to get my system installed in half a day despite wet weather. They matched the system to my energy usage (~25kWh/day). I chose a micro inverter solution because a) easy to expand, b) uses standard 230V switchgear, c) means I donâ€™t have HV in my ceiling and d) is tolerant to failure of one or more panels. The system was supplying energy that afternoon and has consistently generated at 85-90% efficiency since. Iâ€™m looking at approximately a 2 year back period. Very happy so far.
Great local company would recommend to anyone on the Central Coast
Installation is not straight - looks funny. System has stopped working three days after installation

In choosing both a system and size  I found your information invaluable .Because i was having ducted air conditioning installed  I could not accurately ascertain what kilowatt loading would occur- so I opted for 14 jinko 273 w panels interfaced with an enphase micro inverter management system.The system has only been in service 1.5 weeks .During the next 6 months I will  endeavour to ascertain an optimum operational /cost pattern before deciding whether I should increase the installation to 4.8 (5)kw To date, with weak winter solar generation coupled with trial running periods and trialling temperature patterns with the air conditioning, my net export kw is averaging about half of what my average daily usage was before I installed the air conditioning.

Very neat and quality work. Happy with professionalism. Cheaper deal elsewhere but could not say NO to their quality ownership. Proactively gave me extra warranty. Price I paid bit extra but that is worth everything now. From person to let person I just have thanks to say. Keep the good works fellas.

I have learned so much from your site about getting a system that is right for me and not the installer. Thanks for all the help you have given me on any questions I needed to ask and all who work on your site as it is so easy to read and understand.

After being let down by another company and "wasting" 3 months of my time/ sun; All Green (actually the first people I ever spoke to) did exactly what you expect and we're professional throughout. If you value honesty, good communication and punctuality and quality go with All Green. I went with the other guys initially for the sake of a few hundred dollars difference. Lesson learnt.
Communication from quote stage till installation, and after service assistance was first rate. Have recommended to other friends looking for a solar installation.

I have just received my first bill from AGL for this first period using Solar.My bill for this period last year was $400. My bill this period with extra aircon use was Credit $21.92.I can see the potential for great savings over a period of time.I am quite happy to recommend this solar installation to others.
Install team were very efficient, polite and did a great job on the install, phoned & turned up to do a professional job, very happy :)
So far all is going well. Installation was prompt and efficient and app was installed and clearly explained but smart metre yet to be installed and firm date for installation not yet confirmed.
So far so good.
Communication can be a bit slow but it's a busy time of year.
Installation scheduled for later this month
Before contacting solar quote I had very little knowledge about solar . Thank you to Finn and his team for offering an excellent service.
Installer is highly recommended very proffessional..they installed 13 panels even my roof is a bit of a challenge...They installed enphase IQ7 + Suntech 300w panel...

Your website was incredibly helpful in steering me through the maze of issues that need to be addressed in choosing a system and supplier!My sincere thanks.Note:  The system isnâ€™t installed yet, so canâ€™t comment further until such time as it is.
Good quality advice and service.Would certainly recommend them.
Ordered 16 Trina panels, company have installed 6 panels and still waiting on rest of panels to be installed as they have run out. Hopefully issue is resolved soon.

Pros:Technically proficient and a lovely onsite team who were careful and respectful. I felt confident from the outset that this company would deliver a high quality product and they did.Cons:Communicating with this company wasnâ€™t ideal.  I had to chase them for a quote in the first instance and my experience with their automated booking system was poor.  Itâ€™s a one-way street of information and trying to get people to reply to queries/concerns was hard work.

Couldn't complete the install on the Thursday due to rain, but office staff and installers kept me up to date and were back early Tuesday to complete and I had all the necessary paperwork next morning so I could arrange new meter, overall a good professional company to deal with.
Booked for installation in mid March.

At my request (based on knowledge gained from Solar Quotes), All Green provided very detailed quotes for 5KW and 6KW systems in both micro-inverter and optimised single inverter configurations. It does pay to take the time to understand every part of a quote, however, as I picked up an inconsistency in the way the rebate was calculated on some of their quotes. When I pointed this out, they readily acknowledged a glitch in their quoting system, and amended my preferred 5KW micro-inverter quote. Installation was pretty straightforward. They turned up on time in the morning, and the system was up and running early afternoon. On the whole, very pleased with my dealings with All Green, and I recommend them. The Enphase app (and alternative web interface) seem pretty simple to understand. After two days (one of them raining) we can already see that we are saving on daytime usage. Just waiting on our electricity supplier to install a net meter so we can get some credit for what we are feeding in.

Product is excellent. Powers bills fantastic. But then...it rained and rained and I had water inundation through leaking solar panel brackets.All Green came the next day, not fixed.  I hired a plumber to climb into the roof. Sent photos of leaking brackets to All Green and they admitted fault.The attitude prior to the photos was "You have had renovations, maybe the building is moving, maybe the skylights are leaking" None of those. It was the brackets.They had drilled through the tiles where brackets were fitted, creating three leaks. Then tried to seal the cracked tiles with silicone. Doesn't work.It took weeks to sort out. I hired a plumber each time they came to oversee the work.
