After the installers returned they eventually fixed the generation issue on the Enphase system in conjunction with Enphase Australia support.I was not informed as to what the root cause of the issue was!During the week on not generating correctly, I also noticed the 12 x S230 Enphase micro-inverters were consuming ~130Watt at night!I verbally mentioned this to the installer over the phone, on to get the reply that not much.As the system was not generating correctly, I waited until they fixed the generation issue and re-checked to find the system was still consuming ~130W at night. (This was monitored using a separate monitoring device)I emailed the installer a detailed description on this abnormal night time consumption and the fact it would cost me in excess of ~$114 a year because of this night time consumption. Keep in mind the Enphase S230 specifications indicate < 50mW night time consumption. With 12 x S230 that is 0.6W night time consumption, which translates to less than $1.00 a year.The installer replied indicating he had contacted Enphase Australia and they would contact me later that day.Well, it is now more than a week later and there has been no contact from Enphase, BUT later that day Enphase were meant to contact me I noticed the night time consumption had dropped to below 1W night time consumption for the enphase system (12 x S230).I can only assume Enphase updated the S230 micro-inverters remotely and resolved the issue.Everything on the Enphase system (3 phase) is now working as designed, but it would have been nice to be informed as to what was happening and what the issues were.Note: In a normal Enphase system unless there is external to the Enphase monitoring the excessive night time consumption would be hard to detect.

I then waited 2 weeks for the meter to be installed by Ausgrid.I am currently getting a little over 5kWh per day with good sunny weather - keeping in mind that Spring has only just started.

A little slow to react to my requests, but these guys do know what they are talking about. As a journalist working in the electronics market, I know the product well, and am pleased with the package and the cost. Hardly surprising they are snowed under with enquiries. However, the boss came out and surveyed my roof personally. I've just got the installation date, and it will be less than eight weeks from the day I made the initial enquiry through SolarQuotes. Thanks for the help.

Scott doesn't keep you informed as to progress of the job.   He is a no frills person, what you see is what you get, you like him or you don'y .Hopefully he is looking after us.  So far he has instaled the panels on the roof and fitted the circut breakers and the inverter, but it is not conected to the grid.  He completed this on the 18-10-10 as promised and we are now waiting for the meter in the meter box.There has been very little communication from him.   No written guarantee for the panels,  no receipt for payment 10 days ago,   maybe it will all happen next week.I am a retired electrical contractor and have spent many years in the building game, and what has happened so far has been ok.I have the feeling that Scott wont let me down.
Only waiting for the "smart meter" to be supplied. All in all a good experience even through some unfavourable weather conditions.
Too early to comment at this stage the system has not been installed.

Our first contact was with Scott who explained the cost and best system for our home. The installation was done by 2 very skilled young contractors who explained to us how the system works and how to make the most of it. They arrived at our home on time and the job was finished quickly and efficiently. I won't hesitate to recomend Scott and his team to anyone who wants to purchase solar panels and have a trouble-free process.
Would like to get more information after installation. However, it is not completely finished as yet.

Communication was constant from the supplier Scott Ford. Installers turned up on the agreed date and time. Installed the system rapidly and cleaned up after they had finished. System at present awaiting final connection to the grid.

Yes, Scott Ford was very good. I passed Scott's information about my installation to a friend after he received a quote for $5800 for the same 1.5kw and was willing to install the panels. Scott however, advised that solar was not practical due to the amount of shade, saving him the $5800 and my friend was very impressed with Scott and his honesty.
Scott Ford installed the system. All my dealings with him have been excellent.

The inverter company JFY have an Australian support service where the installer acts as a service agent. Panel type & comparing is an area where expert independent opinion would be valuable. Solar Quotes installers obviously have a reputation to maintain.

Your assistance was extremely helpful and took away the difficulty in finding the right supplier and understanding the products available. Overall, a trouble free experience. I would recommend your web site to anyone interested in purchasing a solar system for their home.

I don't know if All Green Environmental Solutions was one of your quotes.  We are very happy with them. They did an excellent job for us and explained every thing in detail!  That was for Toronto NSW 2283.We are also putting in solar at our home at Wisemans Ferry NSW 2775, we are using True Value Solar, cannot comment on service they have not installed my system yet.  But I think they are too big to give the personal care I have received from AGES.  We will have to wait and see.

The whole process is a lot easier than I expected. Scott from All Green has been great. Once I signed the contract I didn't have to lift another finger. All green did all the work and the next thing I new I was producing green power and saving on those electricty bills.
Scott turned up when he said, installed when he said he would and did the job from start to finish with minimal input required from me.
Lacking in communication at some points but otherwise very good . Have not had it conected up yet, that should happen next week.
Everything Sott Ford said would be done, was done by his crew.I have no complaints in any direction, he even chased up Energy Australia  to have the gridconnection within two weeks.
The actual installers were not aware of the scope of the job.

It is a 2.28 kw system. Scott was fantastic he explained all the info in basic terms designed a system for our particular lifestyle and needs with a view to increase size later when it is required. He kept us in the loop when he got behind with the excessive rain. It was installed without any fuss and the installers asked for my opinion as to how I would like the panels on the roof and where I would prefer the box. I would highly recommend All Green Solar and Scott to everyone.

All Green Environmental Solution has offered me the best price that suited my budget. Might not be the highest quality system, however, does the same job like the others. For those who are on budget All Green Environmental Solution is perfect. As customer service,  all were very professional and in time according to the weather. They were very helpul when I needed informations. I recommend them to all.

No angle racks were supplied when installers came to fit the units, so the panels had to be laid at a lower grade than the optimum recommended performance setting. The fitter said "It will be fine we do it all the time".They also marked and scratched my brand new gutters that were only installed 2 weeks earlier.I was told when I agreed to the price that they could have it operational before Christmas, which would have been good as we were going away and it would produce energy while we weren't there but after the fitters were finished I was told it could take another month to be connected to the grid. It took just over 3 weeks.Other than those couple of early concerns, I'm reasonably happy with the performance, so far.

They were easy to deal with. They turned up first thing in the morning to install the panels, which went up without any issues. Still waiting on Nett meter to be installed, but currently everything is looking great. Would definitely recommend this company.
Found the system good value for money. Allgreen were good to deal with and did a good job of installation.

Due to terrible weather conditions (rain and wind) we have had a drawn out installation, however, it is being completed this week.  One would expect this to be a harrowing experience, BUT not so.  Scott and Mark have been fantastic.  Keeping us informed at every step and so very flexible when we had a roof painter who let us down so the installation had to be delayed.((This was our second attempt to have the installation done.  Our first was with Brad Dowton who said he had a system and so we committed to it, but, although promising to send paperwork asap did not.  Did not answer phone calls, did not reply to phone calls during a 2 week period.  When HE was ready to send the paperwork emailed out of the blue to say they were on the way and for us to send them back immediately.  We replied that we thought he'd gone out of business and had gone with someone else.  His response was abusive and downright rude.  We felt very lucky we hadn't waited for him to decide he was ready to attend to us.  We had made our decision based on the fact that we were running out of time to make the deadline of end June and Brad had been insistent that we make the commitment quickly therefore why did we experience the delay and non-response to our calls?))

We chose All Green as is was the best price, but I am disappointed with their lack of communication.  I had to chase them to see if they had received payment and then when installation was.  I feel that they need to keep their customers more informed with what is happening.

I found the team to be helpful and pleasant to deal with. They were very knowledgeable about the system and was more then happy to explain everything and answer all my questions. Very happy. Thank You
The service is very prompt, questions are always answered instantly and they are very reliable as far as coming on the date set.  I am extremely pleased

Have only just had the system installed, Thursday 26th May. Not yet connected to system.Impressed with their timing (installed when they scheduled it), and answered all questions that I asked. Trust the final connection will be done on schedule. Ratings above only rated 4 Good as system not fully installed yet.
We found Scott and all the the people connected with All Green Enviromental Systems so easy to deal with.
They can be a little difficult to contact on occasions. If they are not in the office the call goes to message bank and sometimes it takes them a while to return the call.

All Green Environmental Solutions were very professional and quick with their Quote. Although due to the recent government changes to the solar rebate, the quote needed to be redone. Even with a new quote the price was still lower than any of the other competitors. Since I have not yet had the solar panels installed I cannot comment on the quality of the system nor the installation. I also had Solar Hot Water installed using All Green Environmental Solutions, installed by Apricus. The workmen were great and did a wonderful job. I am extremely happy with the product.

Just a note when installing the new meter system - make sure you have the correct one, as we lost hot water after the installation of the new meter only to find it was an incorrect one. We have a stop clock not a frequency one.
Everything they said they would do was completed, when they said it would be done - grat company to deal with.

The rep from All Green Environmental Solutions was the only one who contacted us. We found him to be extremely helpful, he gave us as much information as we needed, was more than willing to talk to us and we have arranged for both our parents to go with the solar option as well. We are more than confident that they will also be treated with the respect and consideration we were.
Put up 8 panels and another 4 under which does not look good. At present asking to get it fixed, waiting to be done.
Scott has been very patient and answered all our questions about installation and what to expect afterwards. The installation was carried out in less than 2 weeks after we signed the contract.
I'm very pleased that I decided to get solar power and think it's going to be the power source of the future.

System is installed on the roof but not operational to grid yet. It was completed quickly and efficiently in one morning, with all cables hidden, so it looks good.I have no way of telling the quality of any of the systems, but the warranties should take care of any early problems. I would be interested to see how many manufacturuers or installers are around in 25 years for any long term claims.Thanks!

I am very happy with the service I received from All Green Evironmental Solutions. 2 weeks after I paid the deposit the system was installed and two weeks later I was connected to the grid.The installers was very polite and helpful and did a great job.
Not at this time
was booked in for 16th december 2010 , now have been backdated for h january 2011not happy at all , was warned about this

After initial quote, I paid deposit on installation, was given the date ( three weeks after the deposit was paid ). The day before installation was to commence, I got a call from the boss, that panel delivery was delayed and there is another three or four weeks for me to wait. Another phone call last week - " Call you Monday for the date of the installation " . It is Tuesday morning ( today 30st Nov ), I am still waiting for that phone call. It is about six weeks from the initial contact, so maybe I should wait little bit longer. What do you think ?

I havent had the system installed yet so i cant comment on the installation services.All Green Environmental Solutions are a local business to the central coast so i dont expect the best customer service.

Hiscott came and did the inspection on site and had a great chat about the options and then sent through 5 different option quotes  and within 6 weeks we had the instal date and instalation done in 2 hours. only thing holding us up is energy australia with the meter box.

Everything went to plan and now waiting for connection of metre to grid. Worried about the new kw/hr rate now 20c. I'm positive we're locked in until 2016. Also concerned about the current electricity blow out in bills on the Central Coast NSW. Current issue is about Smart metres+ Energy Aust where customers are seeing 100 - 200% increase in bills

We have paid our deposit and our installation date is 21st oct 2010. So far Scott and Emma Ford have been extreamly helpful fantastic at explaining everything came out promptly to do a sight inspection and they were also very prompt with the quote. I can let you know how the installation goes latter if you like. Thanks for recomending them. Janette
System will be installed 13/09/2010
Our Installer wasn't able to purchase German Inverters due to the high demand.The equipment supplied was the CMS 2000 inverter and Sungrid solar panels.

Got two other quotes which were significantly higher for my 3.5kW (20 panel, split between two roof areas, 4kW inverter) system.Have placed order with Scott Ford, but am nervous about installation, which he will do with a subcontractor (since he lives in the bush).Presently wanting to change from Integral Energy to AGL for power, since they give an extra 8 cents for feed in.  Have just called Scott to discuss this and whether it affects my decision, and he has already submitted all the paper work.His advice was to contact Integral to see if they can improve on AGL's offer.

I have paid a deposit but the system has not yet been installed. The company I have signed with was very helpful and did not forget me as did SolarSmith.Scott emailed me, negotiated prices, provided links to websites and also put me in contact with one of his clients.
the installation has not been completed, so cannot provide feedback right now, company has been consistently in contact providing updates on the system, so have been kept up to date.

Please note that I have rated this survey on my interaction with Scott from All Green Environmental Services as we have paid the deposit of $1,300 on a 2.1 kw system and are currently waiting for the rain to stop at Green Point so that we can firstly install the Solarhart hot water and then the solar power system after that.
